Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 10 sec, increasing Holy damage taken by up to 140. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration.
Seal of the Crusader.scaling_note: Grants +306 Attack Power & +40% Attack Speed. Judgement increases Holy damage taken by up to 140.
